metric_definitions.ttft_s: Client wall time from request start until the first nonempty generated content arrives in the SSE stream.
metric_definitions.e2e_s: Client wall time from request start until the streaming response finishes.
metric_definitions.tpot_s: For successful responses with >=2 locally tokenized output tokens: (E2E - TTFT) / (output_tokens - 1).
metric_definitions.token_counts: Local tokenizer counts; input uses apply_chat_template(..., add_generation_prompt=True), output tokenizes generated text without special tokens.
metric_definitions.throughput: Successful requests or their locally counted tokens divided by measured wall-clock span. No server-side KV/cache metric is inferred.
